if: the transaction is the rendering of services
performance consists of the execution of more than one act
no significant uncertainty exists regarding the amount of the consideration
then: revenue is recognised PROPORTIONATELY by reference to the performance of each act, determined on the basis of contract value, associated costs, number of acts or other suitable basis
note: Straight line spreading is a practical sub-case, not the default: AS 9 permits it when the services are provided by an indeterminate number of acts over a specific period, and only unless there is evidence that some other method better represents the pattern of performance. Where the acts are determinate and countable, spread by the acts.

evidence.quote: Performance consists of the execution of more than one act. Revenue is recognised proportionately by reference to the performance of each act.
The revenue recognised under this method would be determined on the basis of contract value, associated costs, number of acts or other suitable basis.
revenue is recognised on a straight line basis over the specific period unless there is evidence that some other method better represents the pattern of performance

evidence.quote: Such performance should be regarded as being achieved when no significant uncertainty exists regarding the amount of the consideration that will be derived from rendering the service.
